sloka: एवं त्वपूर्वदेहस्य वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ।कथितो निर्गमः सौम्य निमेः शृणु यथा ऽभवत् ।। ७.५७.९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ tvapūrvadehasya vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ।kathito nirgamaḥ saumya nimeḥ śṛṇu yathā 'bhavat ।। 7.57.9 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, thus has been narrated the birth of the great-souled Vasistha, who had an unprecedented body; now listen to how it happened with Nimi.
